deploy8.function: ONE call per window on all 8 model slots; prior ha0_ext_pose at the same 8 slots; each surface scored on the call's outputs at its own instants
deploy8.consumer_contract: A consumer selects a surface's RETIME_DEPLOY8 positions like this.  Open DEPLOY8_POS_<tree>_s<seed>.npz (one file per INFERENCE seed).  For surface S in {S2, S6}: `pos = z[f'{S}_pos']` is [n, T, 2] float32 -- the re-timed plan at the surface's instants (`{S}_instants_s`; model slots `{S}_slots`), i.e. the 8-slot call's output indexed at those slots, cast to float32 exactly as RT.retime_apply casts.  Rows are ALL windows of the surface in RT's `surface_inputs` order (the same order as the panel's `os`, which is `{S}_os`, and as `RT.surface_inputs(...)['X']['O']`); `{S}_clip`, `{S}_ws`, `{S}_eid` are the clip index, window origin (provider frame) and episode id of each row.  The COMPLIANT windows are `sel = z[f'{S}_compliant']` (bool [n]; RT's `S['mask']`, = `ctx['comp'][rows]`): `pos[sel]` is what RT scores on the `compliant` set, `pos` the `all` set.  `{S}_pos8` is the full [n, 8, 2] output (S6's rows are a subset of S2's windows but stored per surface), `{S}_plan8` / `{S}_prior8` are the call's inputs, `{S}_pos64` the float64 result before the cast.  To score an arm like RT does: `comp = PR.components(ra, pos[sel], G[sel], dt)` and `PR.paired_cell(...)` with episode ids `{S}_eid[sel]`.

arm_names: RETIME_DEPLOY8 = the condition's arm; RETIME_DEPLOY_PERSURFACE = Amendment 1 table on per-surface geometry (beside); CONST_G1 = 8-slot known-value control
